newsitem.title: USA: NOTICE OF SALE - Carroll County, Md..
newsitem.headline: NOTICE OF SALE - Carroll County, Md..

text.p: NOTICE IS HEREBY GIVEN that the County Commissioners of Carroll County, Maryland (the County'') will receive written sealed bids for the $8,985,000* General Obligation Hospital Refunding Bonds of 1997 (the Bonds'') until 11:00 a.m. local Baltimore, Maryland time on:

at the office of Piper & Marbury L.L.P., Conference Room 7A, Seventh Floor, 36 S. Charles Street, Baltimore, Maryland, 21201. The Bonds will be dated March 15, 1997 and will mature on October 1 in the years 1998 through 2020 as more fully described in the Notice of Sale. No bid for less than all of the Bonds will be considered. The Bonds will be awarded based on the lowest interest cost to the County, determined in accordance with the true interest cost (TIC) method. All bids must be accompanied by a good faith deposit in the amount of $179,700, payable to the order of the County Commissioners of Carroll County, Maryland.
The County will not designate the Bonds as qualified tax exempt obligations under Section 265(b)(3) of the Internal Revenue Code of 1986, as amended.

Copies of the Preliminary Official Statement and the Notice of Sale and form of proposal relating to the Bonds may be obtained from the office of the Comptroller, County Commissioners of Carroll County, County Office Building, 225 N. Center Street, Westminster, Maryland 21157, or from H.C. Wainwright & Co., 100 East Pratt Street, Baltimore, Maryland 21202 (410) 347-3900.
